meta.title: Sniffy Nose
meta.description: Search a perfume and see its notes, level by level.
meta.footer: Notes are gathered from each brand's website and Fragrantica. Pyramids are a guide - your skin tells the rest of the story.

steps.text: Type its name. Adding the brand helps, e.g. "Dior Sauvage".
